findings.finding: The closed side-wrap panels prevent exposed-body gaps, but the profile remains intentionally planar and reads as a rigid technical robe rather than a tailored hoodie shell.
The rear hood panel is attached and face-open, but its manufacturing silhouette is simplified and the edge piping extends above the crown in side views.
Both asymmetric overskirt panels show visible baked settling and deformation at frame 30 and through the pose review.

reviewNotes: Visual inspection completed on the post-cloth five-view and six-pose renders. Geometry, UVs, weights, and cloth evidence are usable for the working Unity integration, but the simplified side/hood silhouette remains explicitly review-required and must not be marked COMPLETE.
